pb-seo-visibility.heading: Answer panels
pb-seo-visibility.boundary: Captured answers show those slots only. No rankings or AI citations are promised.
pb-seo-visibility.empty: No panel yet. Choose buyer questions before collecting answers.
pb-seo-visibility.questionsHint: One question per line, between fifteen and thirty.
pb-seo-visibility.noAnswers: No captured answers yet. Missing slots stay in the denominator.
pb-seo-visibility.measured: Captured slots counted. API answers can differ from consumer apps.
pb-seo-visibility.notLive: Recorded fixtures, not live visibility evidence
pb-seo-visibility.question: Buyer question
pb-seo-visibility.utc: Use UTC for this panel window.
pb-seo-visibility.screenshotHint: Add the screenshot to the order files first.
pb-seo-visibility.error.REQUEST_FAILED: The panel could not be loaded. Try again.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_INVALID: Check the questions, engine names, window and capture fields.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_STALE: This panel changed. Open it again before approving.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_FROZEN: This panel is frozen. Make a new panel to change its design.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_NOT_FOUND: This answer panel was not found.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_SLOT_FILLE: This slot already has a captured answer.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_APPROVAL_R: Approve the panel before capturing answers.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_SCREENSHOT: Choose an uploaded screenshot from the right order.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_API_PLANNE: Live API collection is planned. Capture the answer with a screenshot.
pb-seo-visibility.error.INVALID_VENTURE_: Check the panel fields and try again.
pb-seo-visibility.error.APP_APPROVAL_REQ: Approve this inside the Chausar app.
pb-seo-visibility.website.heading: Website checks
pb-seo-visibility.website.manual: Install lintapple yourself, then import its report. Chausar never installs it.
pb-seo-visibility.website.coverage: Phone and desktop, light and dark. Omitted frames still need your review.
pb-seo-visibility.website.same: The report matches the previous hash.
pb-seo-visibility.website.changed: The report differs from the previous hash.
pb-seo-visibility.website.scheduled: Re-check approved. It needs this desktop and the installed checker.
pb-seo-visibility.website.scheduleHint: Every thirty days, run the installed checker and compare the last report hash. Each new report still needs your approval.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_INVAL: Choose a valid report file and the exact site it checked.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_NOT_F: This website report was not found.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_INCOM: The report needs phone and desktop checks in light and dark.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_STALE: This website report changed. Open it again.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_TOO_L: Split this check by page; it has too many findings to store safely.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_SCHED: This site already has active re-checks. Stop the existing schedule first.
pb-seo-visibility.error.APPROVAL_REQUIRE: Approve this website report before scheduling its re-check.
pb-seo-visibility.error.ROUTINE_NEEDS_CH: Check your AI connection before enabling this routine.
pb-seo-visibility.monitor.title: Bounded site checks
pb-seo-visibility.monitor.boundary: Checks run while this desktop business is open. Each keeps a fresh evidence folder.
pb-seo-visibility.monitor.state.active: Waiting for the next desktop check
pb-seo-visibility.monitor.held: The check stopped. Existing evidence stays untouched. Review it before making a new plan.
pb-seo-visibility.error.MONITOR_INVALID: Use a public site, a full local folder path, and 1 to 10,000 checks at least 60 seconds apart.
pb-seo-visibility.error.MONITOR_STALE: This monitor changed. Review the current plan first.
pb-seo-visibility.error.MONITOR_FROZEN: This plan is already decided. Create a new plan for changes.
pb-seo-visibility.error.MONITOR_DESKTOP_: Open the desktop app to collect evidence into local folders.
pb-seo-visibility.error.MONITOR_NOT_FOUN: This monitor was not found. Open the list again.
pb-seo-visibility.error.NET_ADDRESS_REFU: Choose a public site outside your private network.
pb-seo-visibility.error.NET_URL_REFUSED: Use a plain http or https site address without sign-in details.
pb-seo-visibility.error.FETCH_POLICY_REF: This site does not allow automated reading. Use owner captures instead.
pb-seo-visibility.error.PANEL_ORDER_REQU: Choose a panel linked to this client order.
pb-seo-visibility.website.held: Re-check paused. Install lintapple or review the local checker, then approve a new schedule. No new report was claimed.
pb-seo-visibility.error.SITE_CHECK_DESKT: Scheduled website checks run in the desktop app.
